title: High Point Climbing and Fitness - Birmingham
specs: Indoor bouldering walls up to 45 ft high
Everyone must sign a waiver; minors require parent or legal guardian signature
Minimum age 11 to top rope belay after passing belay check
Minimum age 14 to lead belay without supervision after passing belay check
Children 13 and younger must be accompanied by an adult and cannot use weight/aerobic or bouldering areas
Autobelays require minimum 30 lbs for lowering
includes: Access to climbing walls and fitness gym
Yoga classes and free events included with day pass or membership
gap: Waivers must be signed before climbing; can be completed online or at gym No reservations required for first time climbers orientation Lead climbing classes require minimum 2 persons to run
